legend.title: Legend
legend.hint: A plain line is transfers: the arrowhead and the stronger end are at the receiver. A dashed coloured line is a guess that two addresses share an owner, with its confidence. The fat orange line with numbered hops is the selected path. A name ending in +12 has 12 counterparties folded into it: open it to unfold them.
node.label: Label
node.not_synced: not yet, so its own counterparties are unknown
node.hub: very active address: only its newest transactions are loaded, and traces do not pass through it
named.explorer: its verified contract name at the explorer
form.label: Label
path.hops_one: {{count}} hop, drawn as the fat orange line with numbered hops.
path.hops_other: {{count}} hops, drawn as the fat orange line with numbered hops.
